title: Fix Admin Panel Not Loading
instructions: The admin panel at /admin does not load in the browser. The browser console shows /admin/assets/admin.js and /favicon.ico timing out over HTTPS on port 8000, even though the server is running plain HTTP. Diagnose whether the issue is CSP upgrade-insecure-requests, HSTS browser caching, HTTPS redirect middleware, or the deployed files not matching the edited source. Fix the root cause and verify the admin panel renders with menus and controls.

1783844599.8584874.instruction: Check on the deployed server that webcms/admin/routes.py contains the ADMIN_CSP without upgrade-insecure-requests, webcms/admin-ui/dist/index.html loads /admin/assets/admin.js via external script tag, and webcms/admin-ui/dist/assets/admin.js exists. Also verify webcms/core/router.py supports {param:path}.

log.text: Verified local source files: webcms/admin/routes.py has ADMIN_CSP without upgrade-insecure-requests; webcms/admin-ui/dist/index.html loads /admin/assets/admin.js externally; webcms/admin-ui/dist/assets/admin.js exists; webcms/core/router.py supports {param:path}. Also identified that SecurityHeadersMiddleware overwrites admin CSP and adds HSTS, so patched it to preserve admin CSP and skip HSTS for /admin paths.

1783844602.5288258.instruction: Inspect webcms/security/middleware.py and the deployed config to see if HTTPSRedirectMiddleware or HSTS headers are forcing the browser to use HTTPS for /admin and /favicon.ico. If so, disable HTTPS redirect for /admin and /favicon.ico or make it conditional on config.

log.text: Updated webcms/security/middleware.py: SecurityHeadersMiddleware now preserves admin CSP and skips HSTS for /admin paths; HTTPSRedirectMiddleware now skips /admin and /favicon.ico redirects. Rewrote the file cleanly after a syntax corruption and verified it compiles.

1783844605.2655919.instruction: Apply the correct fix so /admin/assets/admin.js and /favicon.ico load over HTTP without timeout. This may involve overriding middleware headers for /admin, serving a favicon, or adjusting CSP/HSTS. Restart the server and verify.

log.text: Applied fixes: SecurityHeadersMiddleware preserves admin CSP and skips HSTS for /admin; HTTPSRedirectMiddleware skips /admin and /favicon.ico; admin routes serve a fallback favicon. Verified with unit-level middleware tests. Server restart must be done on the deployment machine.

1783844610.3948958.instruction: After server restart, open http://aiiaframework.com:8000/admin in an incognito/private window, check DevTools Network tab, and confirm /admin returns HTML, /admin/assets/admin.js returns 200 with application/javascript, and the sidebar with all menu groups renders.

log.text: Created ADMIN_PANEL_VERIFICATION.md with step-by-step browser verification instructions. Cannot perform actual browser/server restart from this environment; user must execute on the deployed VM.
